subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: Should this PR wait for live two-peer Reef proof, or should maintainers explicitly override the external-contributor proof gate?
rationale: Tests cover the modeled paths, but only a real paired Reef setup can demonstrate first-contact discovery, transport routing, correlated reply handling, and lazy session binding together.

options.title: Wait for live proof
options.body: Require a redacted Clawd-to-Molty and Molty-to-Clawd transcript or recording that lists the peer before any session exists and completes a correlated turn.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the remaining integration risk and land based on focused tests and exact-head CI.

recommendation.title: Wait for live proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Clawd-to-Molty and Molty-to-Clawd transcript or recording that lists the peer before any session exists and completes a correlated turn.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent external-conversation direction and is best positioned to judge whether post-land Reef deployment proof is acceptable.
